# Diagnostic and Screening Studies

This domain covers the design, analysis and interpretation of studies evaluating screening and diagnostic tests.

## Core topics

- Sensitivity and specificity
- Predictive values and prevalence
- Likelihood ratios
- ROC curves and threshold selection
- Serial and parallel testing algorithms
- Agreement and kappa
- Reference standards
- Verification and spectrum bias
- Evaluation without a perfect gold standard

::: {.lipps-callout}
**Why predictive value is not a property of the test alone**  
PPV and NPV depend on the population in which the test is used because disease prevalence changes the composition of positive and negative test results.
:::
